spans.s:
भूय n. (-यं) Abstract state, but used in composition, as ब्रह्मभूय the state
of BRAHMĀ, or identification with BRAHMĀ, becoming of the
same nature, &c.
 E. भू to be, aff. क्यप् ।

. Generally, as a rule 2. Very much.
 3. Again.

भूयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
 1. Much, many.
 2. Abounding. Ind. Fre-
quently, repeatedly, again.
 2. Exceeding, over, above.
 3. Further.
E. बहु much, इयसुन् affix of the superlative, भू substituted for बहु,
and the ई of the aff. rejected; also with इष्ठन् aff. भूयिष्ठ ।
भूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Many, very many, much, most: see the last.
